test.template: Run the project's test suite. Check package.json to determine the test command. Run it, report results, and if there are failures, analyze and suggest fixes.

commit.template: Stage, review, and create a conventional commit with a descriptive message. Format: type(scope): description. Types: feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test, style.

review.description: Run a full code review with confidence-based filtering
review.template: Review the recent code changes in this project. Use the confidence-based filtering approach: only report issues you are >80% confident about, cite exact lines, describe concrete failure modes, read surrounding context. Produce a structured report with CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW findings.

plan.description: Create a phased implementation plan for a feature
plan.template: Create a detailed implementation plan for this feature. Break it into phases: Phase 1 = minimum viable, Phase 2 = core experience, Phase 3 = edge cases, Phase 4 = optimization. For each step include: exact file paths, specific actions, dependencies, risk level. Include testing strategy and success criteria.

perf.description: Run a performance audit and optimization analysis
perf.template: Analyze this project's performance. Check: bundle size, render performance, algorithmic efficiency, memory leaks, network optimization. Report findings with specific file paths, line numbers, and optimization suggestions. Use Lighthouse metrics as reference (FCP < 1.8s, LCP < 2.5s, bundle < 200KB gzip).

deep-research.description: Conduct thorough multi-source research on any topic
deep-research.template: Research this topic thoroughly using the deep-research workflow. Break into 3-5 sub-questions, search multiple sources per question, cross-reference findings, produce a structured report with executive summary, themed sections with citations, and key takeaways. Every claim needs a source.

context.template: Analyze this project's structure, architecture, and coding patterns. Identify the tech stack, project conventions, and any notable patterns. Produce a project overview.

deploy.template: Deploy this project. First check if there are any uncommitted changes. Then determine the deployment method from package.json or config files. Execute the deployment and report the result.

eval.template: Run agent evaluations. Read task definitions from `.opencode/eval/tasks/` and execute each one against the specified agents. Run all judges (test, grep, reviewer) and produce a comparison report saved to `.opencode/eval/results/`. If a task name is provided, run only that task.
